entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕厝乾：字面「房屋干燥/空废」，词头 ala detexado 疑有脱讹，难以确解
entries.en: unclear; lit. 'house dry' (Spanish headword 'ala detexado' unresolved)
entries.notes: 四栏互证失败：M「chû co quy」与 R「chīⁿn cǔn:chīnguiⁿen」音值同「厝乾」及任何常见词均不密合，L 疑有缺损，故不强解

entries.zh: 粉（白铅粉、铅白，可作颜料或扑面粉）
entries.en: albayalde: white lead powder; ceruse (pigment or face powder)

entries.zh: 涵（涵洞、泄水暗渠；汉字栏盲读作「磚」，据音栏改定）
entries.en: albañal: street gutter; underground drain, culvert
entries.notes: M「âm」R「hâm」与「涵」(âm/hán)密合而与「磚」(chng/zhuān)不合，释义从音栏定为「涵」；L「Al banal」即西班牙语 albañal（街沟）

entries.en: albañal: drain hole; culvert opening, gutter aperture
entries.notes: 同上条据音栏 M「âm cá̃ng」R「hâm cǒng」定为「涵空」；词头重复 albañal，逐词分立释义

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕albornoz：摩尔式连帽罩袍、斗篷（汉字栏与官话栏空缺，仅存闽南语释义）
entries.en: albornoz: Moorish hooded cloak; loose outer robe
entries.notes: H 与 R 栏空缺，四栏缺二；M「boa hūe lang : l: liam chīú lang」释义对应不明，词义仅依 L 之 albornoz 推断

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕轎（轿子：人力抬行的坐具）；音栏与字栏不合
entries.en: sedan chair (four columns discordant; gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: 四栏互证失败：M「chiéh ǒâ」与 R「gǜi」均不合「轎」之常音 kiāu/chiào，字栏与音栏必有其一误读，不强解
H「坐」M「chè」R「chō」互证清晰；惟 L「al barda」与坐义不合，词头疑有讹误

entries.zh: 李（李子；词头 albaricoque 本义杏，译以李当之）
entries.en: albaricoque: apricot (rendered with the word for plum)

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕妇人李：义不可解，或为「杏」之别名或残文
entries.en: unclear; lit. 'woman's plum' (variant gloss of albaricoque)
entries.notes: 「妇人李」语义无法定夺，四栏互证不足；音栏仅证「婦人李」三字之音
L「Il bondijas」即 albóndigas（肉丸），与 H「肉員」M「bá ōan」密合；R 栏残缺不碍义

entries.en: alborotar, revolver: to rummage, search through, poke about
entries.notes: M「Xiáu」R「xiâo」音值近「擾」而远「搜」(sou)，音栏或涉「擾」混排；义从汉字与 L 翻寻义（revolver）相合取定

entries.en: alborotar, inquietar: to disturb, unsettle; make restless
alborotar, hacer ruido: to make a racket; cause commotion

entries.zh: 胡闹、闹嚷（搅乱喧闹）〔「草鬧」疑为「噪闹/胡闹」之别写〕
entries.en: alborotar, revolver: to stir up an uproar; rummage into confusion
entries.notes: 「草鬧」字义不明，疑为「噪闹/胡闹」别写；M「cháũ lau」(tshaunn-lāu) 音合，L revolver（翻搅）与闹乱义相取

entries.zh: 变乱（变乱秩序、酿成乱事）
entries.en: alborotar: to throw into disorder, cause upheaval and confusion

entries.zh: 反乱（造反、叛乱；搅乱地方）
entries.en: alborotar la tierra: to stir up revolt, rebellion in the land
alborotar, hacer ruido: to clamor, shout noisily
entries.notes: H「嚷嚷」M「Xiáng xiáng」(jiáng-jiáng) 音合；R「xiáng xiáng」与官话「嚷 rǎng」不甚合，或为音写之讹

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕如〻嚷〻（叠字：人人喧嚷、闹成一片）
entries.en: unclear; reduplicated form, lit. 'all clamoring' (everyone in an uproar)
entries.notes: R「xâi xî」与 M「xū̃ xū̃」互歧，汉字为重文符号，读音所指未能确证；依叠字样式与 L rebueltos（大乱）姑记为众声喧嚷
